content.title: WordPress,
content.body: Pursae rewrites the WordPress core in Go: one binary, one PostgreSQL database, plugins that run in a WebAssembly sandbox and a built-in page builder. The dashboard and the block editor work just as you are used to.

content.title: The WordPress you know, on a brand-new engine.
content.body: Keep your themes, plugins and dashboard; run fewer servers and do less maintenance.

items.title: One binary
items.text: Installation is a single file. No PHP-FPM, Nginx or extra services needed.

items.title: PostgreSQL + JSONB
items.text: JSONB instead of meta tables; queries are indexed and backups get simpler.

items.title: WASM plugins
items.text: Plugins run in a signed sandbox and can never crash the site.

items.title: Built-in page builder
items.text: Drag, drop, publish with Golementor. Without a single line of code.

items.title: Task runner
items.text: Scheduled tasks run in the background without cron.

items.title: Page cache
items.text: Frequently visited pages stay in memory; responses in milliseconds.

content.title: You don't need to be a developer to design your page.
content.body: In Simple mode you only see your texts, photos and colors. When you need more, Studio is one click away.

items.title: Install
items.text: docker compose up -d brings up Pursae and PostgreSQL together.

items.title: Migrate
items.text: Import your existing WordPress site; posts, media and users are kept.

items.title: Publish
items.text: Edit your pages with Golementor and publish them with one click.

content.quote: After moving to Pursae our server bill dropped to a third. Our editorial team did not even notice the difference.
content.author: Ava Martin

items.title: Will my existing WordPress plugins work?
items.text: PHP plugins do not run directly; WASM versions of popular plugins are in the plugin directory and the list grows every week.

items.title: Can I bring my themes?
items.text: Block themes work as they are. For classic themes we offer an automatic converter.

items.title: Is it ready for production?
items.text: 0.1 is an early release. Be sure to read the production checklist before you open it to real traffic.

content.title: Your site could be faster.
content.body: Install Pursae in five minutes, move your content and see the difference yourself.
